title: Marina Budarina — Works (64)
note: One page, Works (64), near-monochrome, a pill filter bar, and title-less masonry cards — show-don't-tell at its extreme. Her steals: the Live filter (31 of 64 visitable) for Play, the count as a headline device, and modal depth for small pieces — with the caution that without titles pieces blur, so it is right for Play and wrong for Work.
